title: Dragon Bridge of Words
description: A hooded figure in a dark cloak stands on the left holding a large paintbrush, painting a long scroll-covered wooden bridge that arches over a dark river. A massive dark dragon with glowing orange eyes and letters spelling 'TO THE OUTCOME' on its wings flies above, while floating books, glowing pumpkins, and a castle with alphabet blocks appear in the stormy background.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene showing a hooded figure with a giant paintbrush standing on the left side of a wooden arched bridge covered in text and small paintings. The bridge spans a dark turbulent river. A large black dragon with glowing orange eyes flies overhead with the words 'TO THE OUTCOME' visible on its body. Floating books, glowing jack-o-lanterns, a castle made of alphabet blocks, and stormy purple skies fill the background in a detailed, atmospheric painting style.
